_about: App crash signatures already dealt with, read by scripts/crashes.py, the digest and health.py. signature is the top AncientTrees frame as crashes.py prints it, on the store build it fired on. fix_commit / first_fixed_build: the code fix and the first build that carries it. server_remedy / contained_at: a server-side fix that stops it without a new build, and when it was applied; crashes before contained_at count as answered. A run that fixes a crash adds its entry here in the same change. Android and the app's own reports (scripts/app_crashes.py, 2026-11-20) match on platform + signature as that script prints it, covering "builds" or every build below "first_fixed_build".

fixes.what: empty-tree feedback crash at launch: MyVotes.treeId took [0] of an empty split (WorthIt.swift:84)
fixes.server_remedy: a general feedback row holds tree='' again: re-run the PATCH submissions?kind=eq.feedback&tree=eq. with {"tree": null} (service key)

fixes.what: 11 Java crashes on 4 testers' phones 11-17 to 11-19, all signed in and collecting; most came right after the My trees tab or a collect. Dove in 2026-11-20: not reproduced (3,000 monkey taps, My trees and camera collect signed in, don't-keep-activities); PostHog's crash handler delivered none of them, though it works on the emulator. Build 4 carries the crash note (ExitWatch.install), so the next one names its line.
fixes.next: first crash on build 4: read its trace with scripts/app_crashes.py and fix it

fixes.what: Species picker with no rows (a search matching nothing): groupedSection read key(0) for its gap item while count was 0, so rows[0] threw. Fixed 2026-11-21 in SpeciesChooser.kt: an empty section draws nothing. Needs a device build to ship. Test: GroupedSectionTest (a recording LazyListScope; fails without the guard, checked 2026-11-21).

Crash during a pan (iOS 27.2.1, 2026-11-20): MapLibre threw from style.addLayer in MapLayers.addTreeLayers (TreeMap.swift:1749 on build 41), from redraw in regionDidChangeAnimated. Its only throw there is a layer name the style already holds. Layer names were base#generation, and the generation restarts at 0 when a style's StyleState is made again (states holds the style weakly) while the last set is still drawn. Names now carry the state's own seq (MapLayers.layerID) and every tree layer goes through addFresh, which removes a same-named layer first. Test: PinRuleTests.aStateMadeAgainNeverReusesALayerName.

One crash (2026-11-16, iPhone 13 mini class, iOS 18.7.8): SIGSEGV at 0xfffffffffffffff0 while SwiftUI destroyed a TreeMap and released a closure MapTab.body captured (closure #4 in closure #1). A released-twice or torn-down object, with no line of ours that does it and no way to reproduce it from one report. Looked into 2026-11-24, no cause found.
fixes.next: a second report of this signature, or one on build 42, names the closure: then read MapTab.body's closures around the TreeMap it builds

fixes.what: One crash (2026-11-15, iOS 18.7.8): EXC_BREAKPOINT / SIGTRAP with an empty stack on the crashed thread and no frame of ours on any thread. Nothing to read; looked into 2026-11-24, no cause found.
fixes.next: only if it comes back with a stack
